title: Multi-Stakeholder Alignment in LLM-Powered Collaborative AI Systems: A Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Tutoring
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of AI governance to align LLM-based tutoring systems with the diverse ethical values of stakeholders (students, parents, teachers, and institutions). It explicitly seeks to bridge the gap between high-level ethical principles and practical implementation by operationalizing stakeholder values into a structured policy taxonomy.
